hazards.control: BOP drills before the job; kill weight fluid or a tested barrier before the tree comes off.
Test the stack to the program pressures; bleed and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Snubbing unit
function: A hydraulic unit with traveling and stationary slips that pushes or pulls pipe through a stripping stack into a well under pressure, so the well need not be killed.

tabs.overview: Used to run or pull tubing on live wells and for fishing under pressure; stationary and traveling slips alternate grip as the jack strokes; a stripper and BOP stack seal on the pipe.
tabs.engineering: Push and pull capacity; stripper rating; stack per API Std 53.
tabs.safety: Pipe-light conditions push the pipe out of the hole; slip sequencing is the control.
tabs.evidence: API Spec 16A (S48), API Std 53 (S49), API RP 16ST (S53), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
